new_result.statement: The full QFORM worst small-ball/density constant equals the supremum over a countable skeleton: rational symmetric matrices with s3>1, product marginals that are indicators of finite unions of rational-endpoint intervals of total length one, and rational target intervals. The affine envelope also admits rational b,c. The optimal constant is preserved exactly.
new_result.key_quantifier_order: First use simultaneous extreme-product localization to fix a compact finite-fragment law; only then rationalize matrix/affine coefficients uniformly on that fixed compact support. This avoids the remote-fragment coefficient-perturbation obstruction.

partner_result_applied.use: Its simultaneous convex-envelope localization is applied with theta equal to all target matrices and Phi equal to the exact interval small-ball functional, yielding equation (4.2) before matrix discretization.

newest_owner_source_applied.use: On the volume-stable cross-block branch the countable affine skeleton obeys the same 24*sqrt(3)*e/(5a) bound, and localization adds no translation/support tax.

unresolved_implication: Prove a universal matrix-structural certificate on every member of the countable skeleton from s3(A)>=1. Current volume/ridge/bank/pair branches are not exhaustive; diffuse, hub and near-null states remain.
next_step: Use the countable skeleton to formulate an exhaustive rational structural dichotomy without any fixed support or fragment complexity assumption, and test it against the known singleton-plus-two-banks and no-pivot families.
